faqs.title: Where did the 6,2, and 10 come from in the beginning of each probability?
faqs.question: I understand the fractions and where those probabilities came from but where did the 6s, 2s, and 10s come from?
faqs.answerTitle: Another Great Insight from your Instructor
faqs.answer: 1/6 is the likelihood of any roll outcome under the F state. 1/2 is the likelihood of rolling a six under the L state.  1/10 is the likelihood of any other outcome (i.e. anything but a six) under the L state.  Note that the question explicitly asked you to calculate the joint probability of both the observed rolls and the hidden states (not JUST the hidden states).
